content: Use pnpm workspace YAML with apps/* and packages/* globs. Name all packages with @melotech/* scope for consistency.
Each package uses its own tsconfig.json extending root, with rootDir: src and outDir: dist. All packages are ESM (type: module).
Docker Compose uses expose instead of ports for web service to avoid host port conflicts in Coolify. Healthchecks on postgres and redis with service_healthy conditions for dependent services.

name: smoke-test-bootstrap
description: Every new package gets a smoke test immediately. The test imports the package index and verifies the exported VERSION constant. This confirms workspace aliases resolve and the package compiles before any real logic is added.

name: centralized-platform-contracts
description: Shared platform contracts live in @melotech/shared, and runtime config derives platform credit env names from SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS instead of duplicating platform lists.

content: Committed .env.example files should show provider variable names and safe defaults, but real API keys should stay as placeholders.
Phase docs require every AI provider to validate an explicit model env variable together with base URL and API key; provider implementations should not hard-code model names.

name: billing-credit-store
description: Phase billing keeps credit pricing and balance mutations in @melotech/billing behind an injected CreditStore; tests use an in-memory transactional store so wallet, ledger, reservation, capture, release, and analytics rules can be verified without a running database.

title: Use Prisma 7 generated client pre-scripts
rationale: Prisma 7 requires datasource URLs in prisma.config.ts and a driver adapter. The db package ignores packages/db/src/generated and regenerates the typed client before build, test, and typecheck so generated code is not committed.
